metadata.title: Manton's Vortex Equations and Anti-Self-Dual Connections
metadata.abstract: We study four of Manton's five vortex equations on a Riemann surface $X$ in relation to anti-self-dual connections. From a solution of each vortex equation, we construct an equivariant holomorphic bundle over $X$$\times$$\mathbb{P}^1$, $X$$\times$$\Delta$, or $X$$\times$$\mathbb{C}$, together with an invariant Hermitian or pseudo-Hermitian metric whose associated connection is anti-self-dual. The equivariant structures are given by the actions of $SU(2)$, $SU(1,1)$, and $SE(2)$, respectively. Conversely, we show that an equivariant holomorphic bundle equipped with an invariant (pseudo-)Hermitian metric gives rise to a solution of the corresponding vortex equation when the associated connection is anti-self-dual.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: Manton vortex 与反自对偶联络
analysis.workSummary: 将五类 vortex 方程中的四类与 X×P¹、X×Δ 或 X×C 上 equivariant holomorphic bundle 及 invariant (pseudo-)Hermitian ASD connection 双向对应。
analysis.breakthrough: 统一多个二维 vortex 系统的四维 gauge 理论实现。
analysis.limitations: 只覆盖四类，且 converse 需要给定等变及 invariant metric 条件。
analysis.priorityReason: 统一多个二维 vortex 系统的四维 gauge 理论实现。
